svg.text: How each part is built, how it communicates, where the risks are and what it costs. Internal only.
Tags: LIVE = running now · BUILT = done, not yet deployed · v1 = first release · v2 / v3 = later

Goal: Customers see their items and bills in one place.

Goal: Start on free tiers while building with zero customers; upgrade only when trading.
Vercel Hobby (non-commercial use only), Supabase free (pauses after 7 idle days, 500 MB database, 1 GB files), Resend free, Sentry free, Turnstile free, OneMap free, WhatsApp wa.me links free
WHEN TRADING: ABOUT US$45 / MONTH + USAGE
Vercel Pro ~US$20, Supabase Pro ~US$25 (no pausing, daily backups, 8 GB database, 100 GB files), WhatsApp API per message, card gateway % per payment (prices to be re-checked before upgrading)
Move to an @ecostorage.sg identity: GitHub organisation, Supabase, Vercel, Resend. Main site keeps its own repo; can transfer to the organisation later with no SEO impact (same domain)
Single master admin (lock-out), WhatsApp API depends on company registration + Meta approval, on-site uploads on weak signal, Vault storage growth from video
